removedUnreportedExceptions.reachability: qs@6.16.0 ships in the staged on-device agent bundle at the evidence pin (docs/evidence/packaged-notices-v14-2026-10-27/third-party-notices.json, SHA-256 a8234035325ae27743684d68daece69ac33331a223c6f62ebce8548522b1db77; upstream elizaOS/eliza fbc2d23d4bae0c7086ea529c019e5a47fb7b8352). The only packaged npm consumer of qs in that inventory is googleapis@169.0.0 -> googleapis-common@8.0.3 -> qs@6.16.0 (bun.lock integrities sha512-IOGMG8tljCZSLvYgdojRu6mB10KEsK0J7X62sXXlQz9koe5BUAW+rqkY3qhQM9wXM6hVL3/Hase7XbxoMyeYiQ==, sha512-7g1yzQKx0mmNTjiK0H9dJ8eqKqDBveES9vLHeg5neb3BMQy/d1oQefIMhIpOVT8a+f+LOcixMEdRbFIW/cQUJw==, sha512-h6fhOIaRrID2CbEY2fqs+7t+UXZo+MLAnU5gRIq85uFtdiUPCdsApMlHhXogKVM4HM2DVbIjGNTTYH2OcmP1vA==). express, body-parser, pepr, and @meteora-ag/dlmm also depend on qs in the full upstream lock, but none of those packages appear in the packaged-runtime notices. GHSA-6pq8-jhm2-2vcw is a DoS only when qs.stringify runs with arrayFormat 'comma' on an array element whose own toString is not callable. Shipped stringify call sites in googleapis-common@8.0.3: build/src/apirequest.js sets paramsSerializer to qs.stringify(params, { arrayFormat: 'repeat' }); build/src/http2.js uses config.paramsSerializer || qs.stringify (qs default arrayFormat is 'indices'). Neither call site selects arrayFormat 'comma'. Input to stringify is Google API request params assembled by googleapis-common for outbound calls; the arrayFormat option is fixed by that library, not taken from request bodies or query strings. This row does not claim a product-wide proof that no future caller can pass arrayFormat 'comma', and it does not assert a process-level error boundary.
removedUnreportedExceptions.justification: Shipped moderate DoS advisory whose vulnerable sink requires arrayFormat 'comma'. The only packaged qs consumer's verified stringify options are 'repeat' or the qs default 'indices', so the comma branch is not taken on the evidence artifact. Recorded as a time-bounded shipped exception so the A-4 packaged-notices gate can stay green while upstream adopts qs >= 6.16.1 (eliza develop tip still resolves qs@6.16.0 under a frozen lockfile; alphaphone prepare uses bun install --frozen-lockfile with no local qs override). High/critical shipped advisories remain forbidden exceptions.
removedUnreportedExceptions.removeWhen: The upstream lock and packaged-runtime notices no longer resolve qs@6.16.0 (prefer qs >= 6.16.1 via an upstream override or dependency bump, then re-run node scripts/dependency-audit.mjs --resident --notices apps/app/public/licenses/third-party-notices.json).
removedUnreportedExceptions.reviewedBy: Alpha packaged-notices gate re-review 2026-10-29 after NubsCarson change request: npm advisory GHSA-6pq8-jhm2-2vcw, eliza bun.lock at fbc2d23d4bae (qs dependents and integrities), packaged-notices-v14-2026-10-27 (SHA-256 a8234035...), and googleapis-common@8.0.3 apirequest.js / http2.js stringify options from the published package tarball
